_note: Three tiers per puzzle, vaguest first. From docs/puzzle-bible.md.

tiers: That tape is not going to fix itself. What would a kid in the 80s use?
A pencil. There's a coffee can of them. Try rewinding.
After the tape plays, think about where Dad said to look. Under things.
hints.solved: This room has given you what it had. The way on is up the stairs.

tiers: The beeper wants something. Who calls a beeper?
There's a phone right there. It has a dial. Use it.
Dad said he put it in his lucky jacket. Where do jackets live?
hints.solved: The jacket gave up its secret. The way on is north.

tiers: That cartridge has been through a lot. What did every kid do to them?
The title card shows you who to look for. The toybox lid agrees.
hints.solved: The trailer is empty now. The way on is east.

tiers: That record sounds like nonsense. What if it's not nonsense?
The clipping is circled for a reason. Try the record the other way.
After the message, who was the one thing Grandpa told Dad not to touch?
hints.solved: The disk box is done. The way on is north.

tiers: The VCR is blinking at you. It wants a tape.
The picture is a mess. VCRs had a control for that.
After the video, think about what Dad did in this room. Saturday, 6 a.m.
hints.solved: The clock radio has done its job. There is a front door past the foot of the bed.
